description: Returns a cut list, a buy list and a plan page with a drawing, cut diagrams and a 3D view for a project given as pieces (name, material, size in inches, position 'at') or as a cedar fence-picket planter (picket_planter: length, width, courses, leg_below). It also returns amounts to buy for materials given by area, volume or count, such as paint, soil, concrete or tile (quantities). Nominal lumber sizes are converted to actual sizes (a 2x4 is 1.5 by 3.5 in). Omitted board lengths, wood type or sheet sizes are filled with common US store sizes and listed under Assumed. The picket planter design includes corner legs, ledger strips under the floor, a center brace when a side is over 4 ft, a ripped floor filler and trim. Prices appear only when stock, extras or quantities carry a price estimate; store prices are not looked up. The saw kerf defaults to 1/8 inch. Divux saves each plan on a page at a Divux link, up to 25 plans a day per connection. Applies to questions about working out a woodworking or building project, or a materials quantity, into cuts and a shopping list.

extras.description: Screws, nails, glue, finish, and tools needed

price_estimate.description: Price estimate in USD for one

search.description: Store-search words, e.g. 'Titebond III exterior wood glue' or 'exterior deck screws 2.5 inch'.

kerf.description: Saw blade width in inches; if left out, divux assumes 1/8 inch and says so under Assumed

parts.description: Piece list for projects other than a cedar picket planter. When picket_planter is also present, picket_planter is used.

at.description: Required. Where each copy sits: its lowest corner [x, y, z] in inches, x across, y front to back, z up. size is in the same axes (x, y, z). Without positions there is no drawing, no 3D view and no blueprint views. One entry per copy. Example, a 24 x 12 in planter 11.25 in tall: front [0,0,0], back [0,11.25,0], left [0,0.75,0], right [23.25,0.75,0].

qty.description: Copy count. When omitted, copies are counted from 'at'.

search.description: Store-search words for this material, e.g. 'cedar fence picket 6 ft' or '1x6x8 cedar board'.

size.description: Real size in inches along width (x), depth (y), height (z)

step.description: Assembly step (1-based) this piece goes on in, matching 'steps'

picket_planter.description: Cedar fence-picket planter dimensions. When set, Divux designs the pieces. For any other project, parts holds the pieces.

courses.description: How many pickets high the walls are. 3 for the low 4 ft box, 2 for the raised and tall boxes.

leg_below.description: How far the legs stick out below the walls, in inches. 1 for the low box, 6.5 for the raised box, 20 for the tall box.

length.description: Outside length in inches. 36 for a 3 ft box, 48 for 4 ft, 60 for 5 ft. Not rounded.

width.description: Outside width in inches. Rounded to whole 5 1/2 in pickets: 12 becomes 11, 18 becomes 16 1/2.

quantities.description: Materials bought by area, volume or count: paint, stain, tile, flooring, fabric, soil, mulch, gravel, concrete

amount.description: Square feet, cubic feet or pieces, when dimensions are not a length and width

dims.description: Inches: [length, width] for area, [length, width, depth] for volume

per_unit.description: What one unit covers (sq ft, cu ft or pieces), e.g. 350 for a gallon of paint, 0.6 for an 80 lb concrete bag

price_estimate.description: Price estimate in USD for one unit

times.description: Repeat the dims, e.g. 2 coats or 4 walls

waste_pct.description: Extra to buy; default 10 for area, 5 for volume, 0 for count

steps.description: Assembly steps in order; pieces refer to them with 'step'

stock.description: Board lengths or sheets to buy, with a price estimate in USD for one. When omitted, common US store lengths are used and no prices are shown.

length.description: Board length, or sheet length, in inches

price_estimate.description: Price estimate in USD for one

title.description: Project name, e.g. 'Cedar planter 24 x 12 in'

units.description: Units for the reply text; imperial (inches) if left out. The plan page has its own switch.
